examined_formations.title: Recurring overseas verification demand pumps -> China local standardized evidence-execution network
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The regenerative field is real, but exact incumbent preflight shows the proposed orchestration functions are already packaged by multiple current China-side execution services, including explicit B2B partner/white-label delivery. The apparent missing edge is therefore not distinct.

examined_formations.title: One-off overseas buyer post -> one local China freelancer
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Paid tasks exist, but the obvious one-buyer/one-freelancer route is already owned by Freelancer/Upwork-like marketplaces and regenerates founder search rather than an operator control layer.

examined_formations.title: End-to-end sourcing or technical inspection -> China sourcing/QC specialist
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current jobs and incumbents show real money, but supplier search, negotiation, engineering judgment, custody and certification make matching expert-heavy and push the operator toward service delivery.

bootstrap_queue.title: Guangzhou bounded factory-existence and visible-evidence visit
bootstrap_queue.why_first: Current, bounded, decision-linked, mostly observable evidence rather than technical certification; budget is materially above the Confirmis micro-task tier.
hard_unknowns: No platform-funded milestone has been observed for our participation.
No compliant team/agency configuration has been established for this account.
No Guangzhou executor is OPTIONED and no same-scope market cost is bound.
Site access/filming permission must be confirmed by the buyer/supplier.
bootstrap_queue.next_safe_action: Do not spend founder validation capital on this task as a core-model probe; preserve it only as payment/scope evidence.

bootstrap_queue.title: Suzhou standardized site-verification micro-task
bootstrap_queue.why_not_first: Excellent repeatability evidence, but US$20-45 leaves little room for orchestration unless execution is truly hyperlocal and aggregated; use to learn task protocol and demand-pump behavior, not to manufacture margin.

bootstrap_queue.title: Multi-supplier technical factory inspection across China
bootstrap_queue.why_rejected: Requires quality/process judgment across electronics/textiles and recommendations; advertised US$2-8/hour is weak for a routed multi-party model and drifts into expert inspection.
